{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Convert revenue to float (though not needed for this analysis, but good practice)
df['revenue'] = df['revenue'].astype(float)

# Filter for NEW customers reached by PAID SEARCH
new_paid_search = df[(df['customer_segment'] == 'new') & (df['channel'] == 'paid_search')]

# Check if any rows exist
print(f"Number of NEW customers reached by PAID SEARCH: {len(new_paid_search)}")

# Check for refunded orders within this group
refunded_in_group = new_paid_search[new_paid_search['status'] == 'refunded']
print(f"Number of refunded orders in this group: {len(refunded_in_group)}")

# Compute conversion rate: fraction of converted (converted == 1)
converted_count = new_paid_search['converted'].sum()
total_count = len(new_paid_search)
conversion_rate = converted_count / total_count

print(f"Converted count: {converted_count}")
print(f"Total count: {total_count}")
print(f"Conversion rate: {conversion_rate}")

# Return the fraction
conversion_rate"}
